// Hash format: scrypt$N$r$p$salt$hash (all hex)
async function verifyPassword(password: string, stored: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const [scheme, N, r, p, saltHex, hashHex] = stored.split('$');
  if (scheme !== 'scrypt') return false;
  const derived = await scryptAsync(password, Buffer.from(saltHex, 'hex'), hashHex.length / 2, { N, r, p });
  const storedHash = Buffer.from(hashHex, 'hex');
  // Length check required before timingSafeEqual (it throws on mismatch)
  if (derived.length !== storedHash.length) return false;
  return crypto.timingSafeEqual(derived, storedHash);
}

key: ratelimit:login:fail:{ip} and ratelimit:login:fail:user:{normalizedEmail}
value: number of consecutive failures
On each failed attempt: attempts = INCR key; lockoutSeconds = min(base * 2^(attempts - threshold), max); if attempts >= threshold, set lockout key with TTL

-- KEYS[1]: failure counter key
-- ARGV[1]: max attempts
-- ARGV[2]: base lockout seconds
-- ARGV[3]: max lockout seconds
-- ARGV[4]: window seconds
local failures = redis.call('INCR', KEYS[1])
if failures == 1 then
  redis.call('EXPIRE', KEYS[1], ARGV[4])
end
if failures > tonumber(ARGV[1]) then
  local lockout = tonumber(ARGV[2]) * math.pow(2, failures - tonumber(ARGV[1]) - 1)
  if lockout > tonumber(ARGV[3]) then lockout = tonumber(ARGV[3]) end
  redis.call('SET', KEYS[2], '1', 'EX', lockout)
  return lockout
end
return 0

-- KEYS[1] = failure counter
-- KEYS[2] = lockout key
-- ARGV[1] = max attempts
-- ARGV[2] = base lockout (seconds)
-- ARGV[3] = max lockout (seconds)
-- ARGV[4] = counter window (seconds)
local failures = redis.call('INCR', KEYS[1])
if failures == 1 then
  redis.call('EXPIRE', KEYS[1], tonumber(ARGV[4]))
end
local maxAttempts = tonumber(ARGV[1])
if failures > maxAttempts then
  local exponent = failures - maxAttempts - 1
  local lockout = tonumber(ARGV[2]) * (2 ^ exponent)
  local maxLockout = tonumber(ARGV[3])
  if lockout > maxLockout then lockout = maxLockout end
  redis.call('SET', KEYS[2], tostring(lockout), 'EX', math.floor(lockout))
  return math.floor(lockout)
end
return 0
